raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 re-delivers 333 transactions (txn_ids 904482 onward) as duplicates. The re-sent copies carry txn_ts as epoch milliseconds, which is the same instant as the ISO original (1768716039000 ms = 2026-01-18 06:00:39), so the cast fails. The fix is to parse epoch-ms timestamps, deduplicate on txn_id keeping the first delivery, and then apply the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, COALESCE(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP), epoch_ms(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT))) AS txn_ts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) d WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
